From: Cotsonika, Nicholas
Sent: Saturday, December 5, 2015 4:23:50 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony
Subject: Idea
This, right here, is a Sunday piece.
Sartori officially joined the Tigers last month from Apple, where he worked after several years with the Blue Jays and Nationals.
“I think going there helped me to develop a good way of thinking outside of baseball, and I can bring that perspective back in the game,” he said.
Why did he leave baseball? What did he learn at Apple that can apply to baseball? Why did he come back? How did the Tigers recruit him? What apps are on his iPhone?
There has to be a great story here with rich detail.
